description: This file defines the SyncWorker class, which performs background work for refreshing coin data, using WorkManager in an Android application.

classes.name: SyncWorker
classes.description: A CoroutineWorker that performs background coin refresh operations and manages work constraints through WorkManager.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Overrides the doWork method to perform the task of refreshing coin data, returning success or retry based on network availability.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a periodic work request for SyncWorker with specified constraints.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the periodic work request for SyncWorker.
